cohort: 9792 extremely preterm infants born between 24 and 28 weeks' gestation, with birth weights <1500 g, admitted to NICUs in 8 different countries between 2014-2015
finding: Variation in NEC prevention practices and risk factors for NEC did not correlate with the variation in surgical NEC incidence between 8 different countries.
country: Australia/New Zealand, Canada, Finland, Israel, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Italy
